newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 6.61 million barrels in the week ended Nov 8 to 305.81 million barrels from 312.42 million barrels the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Wednesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 1.67 million barrels in the week to 242.75 million barrels.
Distillate stocks fell 827,000 barrels to 116.64 million from 117.46 million the previous week. PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 877,000 barrels to 45.01 million barrels.
API said gasoline stocks fell 2.89 million barrels in the week to 187.88 million barrels from 190.76 million barrels. Percent of capacity fell to 90.7 percent from 93.9 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 974,000 barrels to 36.61 million barrels from 37.59 million barrels in the previous week.
